column3: Concerning the 38401 Amrhein Road Mortgaged Property (0.1%), (having an allocated loan amount of $13,775,574 or 0.9% of the related Whole Loan amount), an REC associated with off-site sourced ground water contamination was identified, as evidenced by elevated levels of chlorinated solvents. The environmental consultant provided an upper range estimate within a statistical 90% confidence interval that costs to address additional investigation and remediation would not exceed $227,000.
